High-intensity mottling is localized on the lateral wings. Symmetrically distributed high-contrast circular rings (pixel clusters) are present across both lobes.

other_distinctive_markers: Dominant presence of unique bullseye-patterned ring scars creates a distinctive 'leopard' or 'ring-spotted' visual texture across the ventral surface.
